result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you carousel and inconsistent delivery-fee badge placement on popular restaurant cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with ellipsis so the full name remains readable within the card bounds.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the '€0 delivery' badge sits over the food image while the next card uses a '-20%' discount badge in a similar corner, creating uneven badge hierarchy and visual clutter across the popular list.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge types, colors, and positions (e.g. always top-left for promos) so delivery and discount info don’t compete or look inconsistent.
